scope: Close every case-insensitive combatLevel textual occurrence in the complete Java source tree, proving that the inherited name survives only as PRE-CU hidden combat-skill math, retained authored encounter metadata, fail-closed migration compatibility, exact legacy item cleanup, or isolated diagnostics and never as a player-visible NGE progression axis.

findings: Publish 14.1 player progression is the learned skill-box graph plus named XP pools; it has no player combat-level stat, reward ladder, equipment gate, or roadmap authority.
A hidden combat-skill investment adapter may remain for encounter and combat calculations when it is derived from PRE-CU combat skill boxes and is never exposed as player progression.

Later zones, quests, conversations, NPCs, storyteller objects, target dummies, and treasure encounters remain valid retained content when their authored difficulty metadata is kept behind the PRE-CU player/encounter boundary.
Persisted CU/NGE combat-level state must be removed or fail closed at player migration, respec, NPE guidance, Jedi conversion, reward, stat-message, and item-requirement entry points.
